See also: galéra

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin galea, from Byzantine Greek γάλεα (gálea), from γαλέη (galéē, “type of shellfish”), from Ancient Greek γαλεός (galeós, “shark”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ɡəˈle.ɾə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ɡaˈle.ɾa]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

galera f (plural galeres)

  1. (nautical) galley
  2. (printing) galley
  3. mantis shrimp

Derived terms

[edit]
  • galerada

Further reading

[edit]
  • “galera”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007

French

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

galera

  1. third-person singular simple future of galer

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Archaic variant of galea (“galley”) used in the nautical sense, from which the primary modern usage derives.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡaˈlɛ.ra/
  • Rhymes: -ɛra
  • Hyphenation: ga‧lè‧ra

Noun

[edit]

galera f (plural galere)

  1. (informal) prison, jail, jug
    Synonyms: carcere, prigione, gattabuia
  2. (nautical) galley (long ship propelled primarily by oars)
    Synonym: galea

Descendants

[edit]
  • → French: galère
  • → German: Galeere
  • → Polish: galera

Further reading

[edit]
  • galera on the Italian Wikipedia.Wikipedia it

Anagrams

[edit]
  • regala

  • “galera”, in Richard Stillwell et al., editor (1976), The Princeton Encyclopedia of Classical Sites, Princeton, N.J.: Princeton University Press

galera

Noun

[edit]

galera f

  1. (nautical) galley (ship propelled primarily by oars)

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Catalan galera, from Latin galea, from Byzantine Greek γάλεα (gálea), from γαλέη (galéē, “type of shellfish”), from Ancient Greek γαλεός (galeós, “shark”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡaˈlɛ.ɾɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡaˈlɛ.ɾɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡaˈlɛ.ɾa/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɡɐˈlɛ.ɾɐ/

  • Rhymes: -ɛɾɐ
  • Hyphenation: ga‧le‧ra

Noun

[edit]

galera f (plural galeras)

  1. (nautical) galley
    • 1880, Maria Amalia Vaz de Carvalho, “A Cigana [The Gypsy]”, in Contos e phantasias [Short stories and fantasies]‎[1], 2nd edition, Lisbon: Parceria Antonio Maria Pereira, published 1905, page 143:
      A galera como um cavallo que obedece facilmente á pericia de um optimo cavalleiro, proejou a barra em meio das exclamações dos impacientes e saudosos passageiros.
      The galley, like a horse that easily obeys the skill of an excellent rider, crossed the bar amidst the exclamations of the impatient and nostalgic passengers.
  2. (Brazil, informal) folks
    Synonyms: rapaziada, moçada, gurizada, negada

Further reading

[edit]
  • galera on the Portuguese Wikipedia.Wikipedia pt
  • “galera”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “galera”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡaˈleɾa/ [ɡaˈle.ɾa]
  • Rhymes: -eɾa
  • Syllabification: ga‧le‧ra

Etymology 1

[edit]

From galea, from Old Spanish galea, galia (c. 1270), from Byzantine Greek γάλεα (gálea), from γαλέη (galéē, “type of shellfish”), from Ancient Greek γαλεός (galeós, “shark”).

Noun

[edit]

galera f (plural galeras)

  1. galley
  2. covered wagon
  3. mantis shrimp
  4. (printing) galley, galley proof
    Synonyms: galerada, prueba
  5. (printing) galley tray
    Synonym: galerín
Derived terms
[edit]
  • corrección de galeras
  • revisión de galeras

Related terms

[edit]
  • galeota

Etymology 2

[edit]

From Italian galero.

Noun

[edit]

galera f (plural galeras)

  1. (Southern Cone) top hat
    Synonyms: chistera, sombrero de copa

Further reading

[edit]
  • “galera”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Tagalog

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ɡaˈleɾa/ [ɡɐˈlɛː.ɾɐ]
  • Rhymes: -eɾa
  • Syllabification: ga‧le‧ra

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish galera, from galea, from Byzantine Greek γάλεα (gálea). Doublet of galila.

Noun

[edit]

galera (Baybayin spelling ᜄᜎᜒᜇ)

  1. (nautical) galley
  2. (printing) galley
Related terms
[edit]
  • galeon
  • galerada
See also
[edit]
  • galauran

Etymology 2

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

galera (Baybayin spelling ᜄᜎᜒᜇ)

  1. alternative form of galyera
